# Beggy — Full Reference

> Exhaustive reference for AI models, search crawlers, and agents.

---

## 1. Product Identity

- **Name**: Beggy  
- **Tagline**: Order it. Track it. It never comes.  
- **Voice**: Swiggy. But the food is fake. You keep the money.  
- **URL**: https://beggy.vercel.app/  
- **Country**: India (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad)  
- **Currency**: Indian Rupee (₹)  
- **Creator**: Arunachalam Venkatachalapathy (Bengaluru)  
- **Creator Tip UPI**: `arunking156-2@oksbi`  

---

## 2. Core User Journey

1. **Open**: User visits https://beggy.vercel.app/. Phone-first dark theme. Ticker shows total rupees kept across the network so far. One button: "I'm craving something."
2. **Browse**: User browses 20 fictional kitchens across Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi, and Hyderabad. Real food photos, realistic prices (₹140–₹470).
3. **Cart**: Cart calculates real-world Swiggy math: Item Subtotal + Delivery Fee (₹49) + Platform Fee (₹10) + Packaging & GST (5%) + Late Night Rain Surge (₹25) = TO PAY (e.g., ₹457).
4. **Checkout**: User sees delivery address and greyed simulated payment options. One giant button: "Place order (nothing will come) / Food will not arrive. Money will not leave."
5. **The Slam**: Upon tapping place order, the bill strikes through to ₹0.00 and the 11-minute delivery simulation begins.
6. **The Ride (11 Minutes)**: Real Leaflet dark map with moving rider (Hero Splendor). Staged events: Assigned -> At Kitchen -> Chat bubble ("Bhaiya 2 min, kitchen me rush hai") -> Stuck at signal -> Order picked up -> Chat bubble ("Bhaiya location main gate pe deliver karna hai na?") -> Arriving. "Panic" button offers a blunt reminder: "Sit with it. Drink a glass of water. The craving is lying to you."
7. **The Reveal**: Pure black screen. Giant neon numbers: "Your food was never ordered. ₹457 is still in your account. Biryani • 11:42 pm • didn't happen." Includes bank SMS alert card: "BANK ALERT: INR 457.00 NOT DEBITED. Beggy order cancelled by reality."
8. **WhatsApp Viral Duel**: User enters their first name (e.g., Priya). WhatsApp button activates with pre-filled duel link: `https://beggy.vercel.app/?c=457&dish=Biryani&from=Priya`.
9. **Duel Landing**: When a friend opens the link, they see: "Priya ghosted a Biryani. Rider came. Food didn't. ₹457 stayed in her account. Beat her. [I'll waste more than ₹457 ➔]".
10. **The Bill You Kept**: Local roast passbook tracks avoided food spending and night streaks.

---

## 3. Challenge URL Schema

- **Pattern**: `https://beggy.vercel.app/?c=AMOUNT&dish=DISH&from=NAME`
- **Parameters**:
  - `c`: Integer amount in INR (bounded between 10 and 50000).
  - `dish`: Name of dish ghosted (max 40 chars).
  - `from`: First name of the person who didn't order (max 24 chars).
- **Server-rendered WhatsApp OpenGraph preview**:
  `{Name} just didn't order {dish} — ₹{amount} kept`

---

## 4. Privacy & Zero-Payment Posture

- No accounts, no phone numbers, no credit cards.
- Zero rupees charged.
- No third-party tracking.
